data.long_meaning: Raj means 'rule' and end means 'end' so the name Rajend means 'one who rules at the end'. It is a powerful name that signifies leadership and royalty. The name Rajend carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rajend usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Rajend belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajend total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.context: Rajendra Chola I was a powerful king of the Chola dynasty of the Indian subcontinent. He expanded the Chola Empire to its greatest territorial extent, conquering parts of Sri Lanka, and invaded the eastern parts of the Ganges Delta in present-day Bangladesh and the eastern coast of India, extending Chola influence as far as the eastern coast of the Bay of Bengal. He is especially known for his military victories in Sri Lanka, which are described in detail in the Culavamsa, the last chapter of the Mahavamsa.
